title: core: complexity aggregates + module DAG (complexity.rs, modules.rs)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W2]
Seats: CORE-03, CORE-04
crates/core/src/complexity.rs: aggregates over Analysis::cfgs — per-function complexity sorted, per-file sum/max, nesting extremes, hotspot ranking, unused-variable list, most-used variables, shadowed names (F6 surface). crates/core/src/modules.rs: build ModuleNode/ModuleEdge (Crate/Dir/Module/File + Import/Submodule with counts) from the index's FileEntry tree + import edges; deterministic ids, cycle-friendly. Both consume the frozen analysis.rs contract. Owner: crates/core/src/{complexity,modules}.rs + lib.rs lines. Verify: cargo test -p repowalk-core (inline tests: complexity ranking on fixtures, module tree of fixtures/sample has expected nodes/edges).
